title: ZeroConverter job
description: Input for `zeroconverter validate --job` and `zeroconverter run --job`. See docs/CLI.md.

inputs.description: Files to convert. Relative paths are relative to the current directory.

format.description: Output format id or extension, as listed by `zeroconverter capabilities`.

output_dir.description: Existing folder for the outputs. Default: next to each input.

options.description: Format options. Each family reads the keys it knows (see `capabilities`) and ignores the rest.

max_height.description: Video: scale a taller video down to this height; a smaller one is kept as it is.

channels.description: 1 makes the output mono; unset keeps the source's channels.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing output instead of picking `name (1).ext`.

confirm_large.description: Consent to convert inputs over 100 MB.
